title: Binary inner product bit
statement: For a vector $z\in\mathbb{F}_2^{2n}$, split $z$ into its first and last $n$ coordinates, say $u,v\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$. The binary inner product bit of $z$ is $\sum_{i=1}^n u_i v_i$ computed in $\mathbb{F}_2$.
